## Breaking change
<!--
  If your PR contains a breaking change for existing users, it is important
  to tell them what breaks, how to make it work again and why we did this.
  This piece of text is published with the release notes, so it helps if you
  write it towards our users, not us.
  Note: Remove this section if this PR is NOT a breaking change.
-->
The Verisure integration needs to be re-authenticated after the update because the integration is build on a new API.
Mouse detectors have been removed due to a lack of available testers with these types of devices.

## Proposed change
<!--
  Describe the big picture of your changes here to communicate to the
  maintainers why we should accept this pull request. If it fixes a bug
  or resolves a feature request, be sure to link to that issue in the
  additional information section.
-->
The python-verisure pakcage has been updated to work with the new GraphQL API instead of the old REST API. New Verisure devices like the Danalock Smartlock and cameras with motion detection are only supported in the new API.

review_comments: All these gets are so ugly... can't we improve that in the library?
The library doesn't return any typed models. That would require a very large change on the library, that I am not the owner of.

I think we can't do much about it in that case 👍 

../Frenck
If we only return the first item in the list, why do we unpack them all in that case? Sounds rather inefficient.Find the first item in the overview in that case and unpack that.
It'snot all that heavy on performance. Does this block the PR?
Well, yes, it is a requested change review comment.
This is currently being raised in `async_setup_entry`, we don't need to raise in two spots, so I would suggest removing the check/condition/raise from `async_setup_entry`).
Does this return multiple installations now?
Right, but since we just pick of the first one from the list, it means the integration is broken when using multiple installations from a single account now.
The cal in `async_setup_entry` should raise an `ConfigEntryNotReady` in case this happens
